race.title: mallardjewellers.com Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: WOLF RAYET showed improved form upped to the highest level on his final 2 outings last season, making the frame in the Anniversary Hurdle at Aintree, and he can take advantage of this drop into maiden company. Heading the list of dangers is Get Out Of My Way , who was only narrowly denied on hurdling debut, ahead of Old Habits . WOLF RAYET (IRE) GET OUT OF MY WAY (IRE) OLD HABITS (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Wolf Rayet (7/4), Made In Reugny (9/4), Get Out Of My Way (10/3), Mourne Crystal (7/2), Lastbutnotleased (7/2), Lion Rose Sivola (13/2), Old Habits (7/1), En Or (7/1), Airds Moss (16/1), Super Junior (28/1), Arc Zoosve (50/1), Tide Is Turning (125/1), Island Getaway (125/1), Dernier Set (150/1)
